item.title: Filthy roads, 17th August
item.description:
Moorfield road has not been cleaned in months. There is rubbish everywhere from one end of the street to the other. Weeds and leaves everywhere and dropped litter. The whole road is filthy and dog poo on the pavements. Needs attention. Chislehurst road is always filled with fly tipped rubbish and trolleys. Plus alcohol cans and bottles, not to mention the constant problem with drug use and car theft. These two streets are extremely neglected. I would be interested to know why these roads are not taken care off unlike the surrounding roads???? Please could someone contact me because I am constantly having to report problems here. As far as I can see, someone will pick up the cans and bottles but the roads are never cleaned properly. Why? What are we paying for. I have seen council workings sweeping rubbish off the tops of electricity boxes into the floor and leaving it there’s is this the work of a street cleaner? Come on this is just not good enough. Email is Louisestimson1@hotmail.co.uk.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Moorfield Road, Goddington, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.description:

It has already been reported to the council by another resident. No action has been taken despite the status showing as fixed. Please could you resolve ASAP before it attracts animals and leads to more dumping. Thank you.

item.title: Pavement is not obvious, 17th August
item.description:
I drove along Crystal Palace Parade and turned around at the roundabout with Fountain Drive.. Why is there a pavement at all between the two lanes of traffic?. I knocked into it and damaged both left hand tyres. I have driven round here before safely but I would say this pavement is dangerous and unnecessary. In fact I found myself in the lane for the traffic lights and had to go into the lefthand lane. I am disabled and am now without a car for 10 days as the garage cannot fix it until the 26th and there ar e no loan cars available until Sept 1.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Crystal Palace Parade, Crystal Palace, Greater London
